steps.evidence: Every maintained product is a row in the ledger, with a tracking issue per piece of work (linked below)

Add to list on core v0.15.0's action model. Web: https://github.com/spoonjoy/spoonjoy-v2/pull/720 merged, queue run green on the merged commit with light/dark 2x shots (https://github.com/spoonjoy/spoonjoy-v2/actions/runs/43793106645). Apple: https://github.com/spoonjoy/spoonjoy-apple/pull/370 merged, required checks green; light/dark 2x shots in https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-ui/issues/1013#issuecomment-6906177354

Ouro MD: document actions declared once (https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-md/pull/171), generator from core v0.15.0 by hash (https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-md/pull/176, released and verified as v0.9.117); the Edit menu's Add to Markdown Document runs the generated action, light/dark 2x shots in https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-md/actions/runs/43791472037

Rerunnable suite in `scripts/agent-benchmark/`: Ouro UI's action model vs browser driving (Playwright) vs a UI-SDK-style bridge vs plain MCP, same model, prompt and task words per arm, success checked on app state, with steps, time, tokens, cost and every transcript kept. Tasks in Pantry (Spoonjoy-shaped add to list, recipe to list, tick off, refuse to pay) and Ouro MD's own actions (https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-ui/pull/1632, https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-ui/pull/1635). Published with methodology: https://ui.ouroboros.bot/docs/agent-interfaces/ (712 trials, 10 models); the ledger reads it (https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-ui/pull/1636). Dispatchable on a standard runner: https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-ui/actions/runs/43807974404 (scripted agent, every arm and task). Model reruns in CI need the `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` repository secret, which is not set yet. The App Intents arm stays a hook (#1156).
Rerun after the backlog lands; the site headline derives only from the run's output, with methodology and transcripts published
